mapper.sql: id, entity_type, left_entity_id, right_entity_id, match_basis, CAST(evidence_json AS CHAR CHARACTER SET utf8mb4) AS evidence_json, status, source_id, rule_version, version, created_at, updated_at
mapper.select:
SELECT FROM duplicate_candidate
ORDER BY id LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT FROM duplicate_candidate WHERE id = #{candidateId} FOR UPDATE

choose.when: SELECT CAST(JSON_OBJECT( 'displayName', COALESCE(JSON_UNQUOTE(title_override.field_value), a.title_original, a.title_normalized), 'sourceTitle', COALESCE(a.title_original, a.title_normalized), 'doi', a.doi_normalized, 'type', COALESCE(JSON_UNQUOTE(type_override.field_value), a.achievement_type), 'language', COALESCE(JSON_UNQUOTE(language_override.field_value), a.language), 'publicationDate', COALESCE(JSON_UNQUOTE(date_override.field_value), a.publication_date), 'datePrecision', a.date_precision, 'version', a.version, 'sourceCount', (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM achievement_source s WHERE s.achievement_id = a.id), 'authorCount', (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM achievement_author au WHERE au.achievement_id = a.id) ) AS CHAR CHARACTER SET utf8mb4) FROM achievement a LEFT JOIN manual_field_override title_override ON title_override.achievement_id = a.id AND title_override.field_name = 'title' AND title_override.active = TRUE LEFT JOIN manual_field_override type_override ON type_override.achievement_id = a.id AND type_override.field_name = 'type' AND type_override.active = TRUE LEFT JOIN manual_field_override language_override ON language_override.achievement_id = a.id AND language_override.field_name = 'language' AND language_override.active = TRUE LEFT JOIN manual_field_override date_override ON date_override.achievement_id = a.id AND date_override.field_name = 'publicationDate' AND date_override.active = TRUE WHERE a.id = #{entityId}

mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM achievement_source s JOIN achievement_source_snapshot snapshot ON snapshot.achievement_source_id = s.id JOIN achievement target ON target.id = CASE WHEN s.achievement_id = #{leftId} THEN #{rightId} ELSE #{leftId} END JOIN JSON_TABLE(snapshot.normalized_payload, '$.scholarlyMetadata.versionRelations[*]' COLUMNS (relation_type VARCHAR(32) PATH '$.relationType', target_doi VARCHAR(255) PATH '$.targetDoi')) relation_value WHERE s.achievement_id IN (#{leftId}, #{rightId}) AND target.doi_normalized = relation_value.target_doi AND relation_value.relation_type IN ('is-preprint-of', 'has-preprint', 'is-version-of', 'has-version') )

choose.when: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM achievement WHERE id = #{entityId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM author WHERE id = #{entityId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM organization WHERE id = #{entityId}
choose.otherwise: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM venue WHERE id = #{entityId}

mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM canonical_entity_link WHERE entity_type = #{entityType} AND entity_id = #{entityId}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM canonical_entity_link WHERE entity_type = #{entityType} AND entity_id = #{entityId} AND revision_id = #{revisionId}

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM merge_decision WHERE candidate_id = #{candidateId} AND id > #{decisionId}

mapper.update: UPDATE manual_field_override SET field_value = #{row.fieldValue}, revision_id = #{row.revisionId}, actor_user_id = #{row.actorUserId}, reason = #{row.reason}, active = #{row.active}, version = version + 1, updated_at = #{row.updatedAt} WHERE id = #{row.id} AND version = #{expectedVersion}
